newsitem.title: JORDAN: French President Chirac arrives in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: French President Chirac arrives in Jordan.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac arrived in Amman on Wednesday for talks with Jordan's King Hussein.

He was met by the king at Amman's Marka airport. The French president, who became the first foreign leader to address the Palestinian legislature in the West Bank town of Ramallah on Wednesday, was given a 21-gun salute.
Chirac was due to hold a private meeting with the king before a formal dinner. On Thursday he will address Jordanian senators and parliamentary deputies.

Chirac's campaign to seek a greater European role in the Middle East ran into strong opposition during his visit to Israel but was well received by Jordan's official press and parliamentary opposition parties.
